matches.notes: Club (official): 2-0 at Sammy Ofer, fixture 17, Azoulay 35', Melamed 45+12'. Sports Mole: Mon 5 Jan 2026, 2-0, Melamed 45+11'. Wikipedia: 5 Jan 2026, 45+11'. Minute taken from the club report.
Club (official, report dated 22 Sep): 1-1, Stewart 14', Zikri 38'. Wikipedia: 21 Sep 2025, 1-1, Zikri listed at 33'. Sports Mole H2H: 21 Sep 2025 Hapoel 1-1 Maccabi. Minutes per club.
Club (official, dated 4 May): 1-5, East 12/29/54, Diarra 41/50, Melamed 79. Sports Mole: Sat 3 May 2025, East third at 52'. Sports Rabbi: East 52'. Wikipedia: 3 May 2025, East 54'. Minutes per club.
Club (official, dated 30 Mar) and Sports Mole (29 Mar 2025): 0-2, Saief 38', Melamed 75'. Wikipedia lists Melamed at 52' (outvoted).
Sports Mole: 10 Feb 2025, 1-1, Goldberg o.g. 55', Refaelov 90+8'. Wikipedia: same, o.g. credited to Hapoel. Venue Sammy Ofer only per Sports Mole, so null.

Club (official): Hapoel home at Teddy Stadium (security situation), 1-4; Saba 41' and 84' pen, Refaelov 72' pen, Severina 90+3', Melamed 52' pen (club intro also says 83'/73'). Sports Mole: 4 Nov 2024, Refaelov 73'. JPost: Monday 4 Nov, Melamed 53'. Wikipedia agrees with club timeline. Minutes per club timeline.

Club (official): Maccabi home, Hapoel won 2-0, Melamed (then Hapoel) 45+13' pen and 48'. Sports Mole: 25 May 2024, header 0-2 (its goal list also shows a David 36' entry inconsistent with that score; ignored). Wikipedia: 25 May 2024, 0-2.
Club (official): Hapoel home at Sammy Ofer, 0-2, David 72' and 73'. Sports Mole: 29 Apr 2024, David 72' and 74'. Wikipedia: 72', 74'. Minutes per club.
Wikipedia and Sports Mole H2H agree: 18 Feb 2024, Maccabi 1-1 Hapoel. Scorers (Kinda 15', Yosefi 56') only on Wikipedia, so null.
Wikipedia and Sports Mole H2H agree: 17 Dec 2023, Hapoel 0-3 Maccabi. Scorers (Refaelov 2, David) only on Wikipedia, so null.

Wikipedia: 6 Mar 2023, 4-1, Atzili 3/5/72, Chery 56, Serdal 69. Sports Rabbi (dated 6 Mar 2023): 4-1, Atzili two inside five minutes, Chery 56', Sardel about a quarter-hour later, Atzili third (no minute). Names agree; only Chery's 56' is stated by both, so all other minutes are null.
Wikipedia: 4 Jan 2023, R16, 5-1. Soccerway: 04/01/2023 State Cup 1/8-final, Maccabi home 5-1. worldfootball.net: 2022/23 R16 Maccabi 5:1 (HT 2:0). Scorers only on Wikipedia, so null.

Planet Sport and Babagol: 19 Apr 2022, semi-final, 2-0. Wikipedia lists 19 May 2022 (outvoted). Venue disputed (Planet Sport: Sammy Ofer; Babagol: Bloomfield) so null. First scorer disputed (Planet Sport: Menachem 43'; Babagol and Wikipedia: Dean David ~43') and Chery's minute differs (52/~51), so scorers null.

Planet Sport: 2 Dec 2021, round 11, Maccabi home 5-1; goals 16' and 45' unnamed, Haziza 18', Ožbolt 56', Atzili 72', Donyoh 90'. Sports Rabbi: David 2, Atzili, Haziza, Donyoh; Ožbolt. Wikipedia: David 16/45, Haziza 18, Ožbolt 57, Atzili 72, Donyoh 84. Names agree; Ožbolt and Donyoh minutes disagree and David's minutes rest on one named source, so those are null.

Wikipedia: 21 Nov 2020, Hapoel 2-1, Zamir 69, Rukavytsya 84, Serdal 90+1. JPost (24 Nov 2020, 'over the weekend'): Hapoel 2-1, Zamir 69', Rukavytsya pen 84', Sardel 91'. Date from Wikipedia, consistent with JPost's weekend.

Wikipedia: 1 Jul 2020, Hapoel 1-4, Rukavytsya 4/23, Sallalich 9/25, Sylvestr 70. FotMob: 1 Jul 2020, Championship Group round 34, Rukavytsya 4/23, Sallalich 9/26, Sylvestr 72. Sallalich second and Sylvestr minutes disagree, so null.

Wikipedia: 27 Oct 2013, Maccabi 0-1 Hapoel, Korać 13'. JPost (published 28 Oct 2013): Hapoel 1-0 'Haifa derby conquest', Korac 13'. JPost gives no match date or home side; date and home from Wikipedia, consistent with the next-day article. Confidence lowered for that reason.

Wikipedia: 28 Dec 2009 (a Monday), Hapoel 0-1 Maccabi, Golasa 33'. JPost: league match on a Monday night at Kiryat Eliezer, Hapoel 0-1, Golasa 32'. Minute disagrees by one, so null; venue only in JPost, so null.
RSSSF: round 28, 4 May 1996, Maccabi 2-0, Harazi 88, Hazan 90. Wikipedia identical.
RSSSF: round 13, 16 Dec 1995, Hapoel 2-1, Atar 31 pen, Turjeman 52, Kandaurov 72. Wikipedia: Atar 32, Turgeman 51, Kandaurov 72. Atar and Turgeman minutes differ by one, so null.
